# Wildberries
> Wildberries is a major Russian e-commerce marketplace for shopping, selling, delivery, and partner services.

Wildberries operates a large online marketplace with customer-facing shopping services and dedicated portals for sellers, partners, logistics, and developers. Its ecosystem includes marketplace tools, advertising, analytics, fulfillment, and API integrations.

## Main Platform
- [Wildberries Home](https://www.wildberries.ru/): Main marketplace homepage for browsing products, categories, promotions, and customer services.
- [Catalog](https://www.wildberries.ru/catalog): Product catalog entry point for navigating marketplace categories and listings.
- [Basket](https://www.wildberries.ru/lk/basket): Customer shopping basket for reviewing selected products before checkout.
- [Profile](https://www.wildberries.ru/lk): Personal account area for orders, returns, addresses, and account settings.
- [Brands](https://www.wildberries.ru/brands): Brand directory for exploring products by manufacturer and label.
- [Sales and Discounts](https://www.wildberries.ru/promotions): Promotions page with discounts, campaigns, and special marketplace offers.

## Customer Help
- [Help Center](https://www.wildberries.ru/services/besplatnaya-dostavka): Customer service information and service-related guidance on marketplace operations.
- [Delivery Information](https://www.wildberries.ru/services/dostavka): Delivery terms, methods, timing, and order receipt information.
- [Payment Information](https://www.wildberries.ru/services/sposoby-oplaty): Supported payment methods and payment process details for customers.
- [Returns](https://www.wildberries.ru/services/vozvrat-tovara): Product return rules, procedures, and refund-related information.
- [Contacts](https://www.wildberries.ru/services/kontakty): Contact and support information for customer communication channels.
- [FAQ](https://www.wildberries.ru/services/voprosy-i-otvety): Frequently asked questions covering common shopping and service topics.

## Sellers and Marketplace Partners
- [WB Partners](https://seller.wildberries.ru/): Seller portal for marketplace merchants managing products, orders, and operations.
- [Seller Registration](https://seller.wildberries.ru/registration): Onboarding entry point for new sellers joining the Wildberries marketplace.
- [Seller Login](https://seller.wildberries.ru/): Authentication portal for existing sellers accessing marketplace tools.
- [Tariffs and Commissions](https://seller.wildberries.ru/dynamic-product-categories-and-rates): Information on category rates, commissions, and marketplace commercial terms.
- [Analytics](https://seller.wildberries.ru/analytics): Seller analytics tools for sales, assortment, and business performance monitoring.
- [Supplies and Warehouses](https://seller.wildberries.ru/supplies-management): Seller tools for managing deliveries, supplies, and warehouse interactions.

## Developer Platform
- [WB Developers](https://dev.wildberries.ru/): Developer portal for integrating with Wildberries APIs and partner systems.
- [API Documentation](https://dev.wildberries.ru/openapi): OpenAPI-based documentation for Wildberries platform integrations.
- [Content API](https://dev.wildberries.ru/openapi/work-with-products): API methods for working with product cards and content data.
- [Prices and Discounts API](https://dev.wildberries.ru/openapi/prices): API endpoints for updating prices and discount information.
- [Marketplace API](https://dev.wildberries.ru/openapi/orders-fbs): API operations for orders, supplies, and marketplace workflows.
- [Statistics API](https://dev.wildberries.ru/openapi/reports): Reporting and statistics endpoints for seller performance and sales data.

## Advertising
- [WB Promotion](https://promotion.wildberries.ru/): Advertising platform for marketplace promotion and sponsored product campaigns.
- [Advertising Account](https://promotion.wildberries.ru/): Entry point for managing advertising campaigns and budgets.
- [Campaign Analytics](https://promotion.wildberries.ru/statistics): Performance statistics and reporting for advertising placements.
- [Promotion Tools](https://promotion.wildberries.ru/tools): Advertising instruments for campaign setup and marketplace visibility growth.

## Logistics and Fulfillment
- [WB Cargo](https://cargo.wildberries.ru/): Logistics portal for transportation, cargo handling, and supply chain operations.
- [Warehouse Map](https://seller.wildberries.ru/warehouses): Seller-facing warehouse information for planning supplies and fulfillment.
- [Supply Management](https://seller.wildberries.ru/supplies-management): Tools for creating and tracking inbound marketplace supplies.
- [Acceptance Coefficients](https://seller.wildberries.ru/dynamic-product-categories-and-rates): Operational and commercial information affecting supply planning and placement.

## Careers and Corporate
- [Careers](https://job.wildberries.ru/): Recruitment portal with vacancies and employment information across Wildberries operations.
- [Corporate Site](https://www.wildberries.ru/services/o-kompanii): Company information, marketplace background, and corporate details.
- [Press Center](https://www.wildberries.ru/services/press-tsentr): Official news, announcements, and media materials about Wildberries.
- [Investor and Business Information](https://www.wildberries.ru/services/rekvizity): Company requisites and formal business information.

## Legal and Policies
- [User Agreement](https://www.wildberries.ru/services/pravila-polzovaniya-torgovoy-ploshchadkoy): Terms governing use of the Wildberries marketplace platform.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.wildberries.ru/services/politika-konfidentsialnosti): Personal data processing and privacy policy for platform users.
- [Public Offer](https://www.wildberries.ru/services/publichnaya-oferta): Public offer and contractual terms for purchases on the marketplace.
- [Return Rules](https://www.wildberries.ru/services/vozvrat-tovara): Legal and procedural rules for returning purchased goods.
- [Personal Data](https://www.wildberries.ru/services/personalnye-dannye): Information on personal data handling and related user rights.

## Mobile and Digital Services
- [Mobile App Information](https://www.wildberries.ru/services/mobilnoe-prilozhenie): Information about Wildberries mobile applications and app usage.
- [Digital Products](https://www.wildberries.ru/catalog/knigi/tsifrovye-knigi): Marketplace section for digital goods and electronic products.
- [Gift Certificates](https://www.wildberries.ru/catalog/podarki/podarochnye-sertifikaty): Gift certificate listings and related marketplace offerings.
